strings.PSO/DE/GWO/WOA/SCA 的教科书公式本来是为实数空间写的——这里不: The textbook formulas of PSO / DE / GWO / WOA / SCA were written for real-valued spaces — here nothing is discretised and they run as published. After this page, go back to the TSP page and you will see what discretisation changed.
strings.灰底热力图是目标函数地形（越暗=越低=越好），粒子是候选解，十字标是全局最优。四: The grey heat map is the landscape of the objective (darker = lower = better), particles are candidate solutions and the cross marks the global optimum. Each of the four benchmark functions tests something different:
strings.Sphere（单峰碗状）：考收敛速度；Rosenbrock（香蕉谷）：谷底平坦，: Sphere (a unimodal bowl): tests convergence speed; Rosenbrock (banana valley): a flat valley floor that tests fine stepping; Rastrigin (sharp valleys everywhere): tests the ability to escape local optima; Ackley: nearly flat globally with a rough edge.
strings.把维度切到 10 维再跑一次——低维演示里凶悍的算法可能当场翻车，这是「维度灾难: Switch to 10 dimensions and run again — an algorithm that looks fierce in the low-dimensional demo can fall apart on the spot, an intuitive version of the “curse of dimensionality”.
strings.注意 Rastrigin 列：随机搜索 0.62 比单链方法（SA/HC）还好—: Note the Rastrigin column: random search at 0.62 beats the single-chain methods (SA/HC) — in low dimensions with cheap evaluations uniform sampling is a strong baseline, common knowledge in the metaheuristics literature that few people say aloud. The population algorithms (PSO/DE/GWO/WOA/SCA) reach 0 through population diversity plus fine contraction.
strings.原生域：速度-位置公式原样，不做任何离散化: Native domain: the velocity–position formulas unchanged, no discretisation
strings.为什么随机搜索在 Rastrigin 上比 SA/HC 还强？: Why is random search stronger than SA/HC on Rastrigin?
strings.2D、评价便宜时，均匀采样 6000 个点的最好值本来就约 0.6，而单链算法容: In 2D with cheap evaluations the best of 6000 uniform samples is about 0.6 anyway, while single-chain algorithms easily get stuck in one sharp valley. SA is not written wrongly — this is the objective behaviour of a multimodal landscape in low dimensions. Switch to 10 dimensions: random search fails immediately and the advantage of population algorithms shows.
strings.热力图在 10 维时还准吗？: Is the heat map still accurate in 10 dimensions?
strings.热力图只画前两个维度（其余维度固定 0），粒子位置也只投影前两维——你看到的是高: The heat map only draws the first two dimensions (the others fixed at 0) and the particle positions are projected onto them too — what you see is the shadow of a high-dimensional search on a 2D slice. The convergence curve always shows the true high-dimensional objective value.
strings.PSO 的速度上限是干什么用的？: What is the velocity limit of PSO for?
strings.速度不限的话粒子会飞出边界来回震荡，永远进不了谷底。本站限制单代位移不超过搜索域: Without a velocity limit particles fly out of the boundary and oscillate, never settling into the valley. The site limits the per-generation displacement to 20% of the search domain, a standard engineering practice for PSO.
strings.给图的每个顶点染色，相邻顶点不能同色，用的颜色种类越少越好。排课表、寄存器分配、: Colour every vertex of a graph so that adjacent vertices differ, using as few colours as possible. The abstract prototype of timetabling, register allocation and channel assignment.
strings.图着色是组合优化的另一棵常青树。本页的编码方案值得细看：解 = 顶点的一个排列，: Graph colouring is another evergreen of combinatorial optimisation. The encoding on this page deserves a close look: solution = a permutation of the vertices, decoding = give each vertex in permutation order “the smallest colour its neighbours have not used” (First-Fit greedy). The order of the permutation determines the colouring quality — the algorithm's job is to find a good order.
strings.这和 TSP 是同一种编码（排列），只是解码器换了：TSP 把排列当访问顺序，图: This is the same encoding as TSP (a permutation) — only the decoder changes: TSP treats the permutation as a visiting order, graph colouring as a colouring priority. The objective is the lexicographic “number of colours k + Σci²”: the colour count is the main criterion, and Σci² (sum of squared colour-class sizes) encourages emptying high-numbered colour buckets — the colour count is an integer so it falls in steps, and during a plateau the algorithm is actually optimising the secondary criterion to build up potential.
strings.实例是 DSJC 均匀随机图（n=50 p=0.5 时随机序 FF 要 12 色: The instances are DSJC uniform random graphs (with n = 50, p = 0.5 random-order FF needs 12 colours, optimisation gives 10–11). Lesson from measurement: random geometric graphs are too “structured” — random-order First-Fit is already nearly optimal there — only hard graphs such as DSJC reveal differences between algorithms.
strings.实测参考（DSJC n=50 p=0.5，seed=7，200 代）: Measured reference (DSJC n = 50, p = 0.5, seed = 7, 200 generations)
strings.注意色数列是阶梯状下降——色数是整数，算法大部分时间在同一个色数平台上优化 Σc: Note that the colour column falls in steps — the colour count is an integer and the algorithm spends most of the time on one colour-count plateau optimising Σci² (using colours more “compactly”) until it has built enough potential to drop to the next count. DSJC uniform random graphs are the standard hard instances in the literature: on random geometric graphs random-order First-Fit is almost optimal and no difference can be measured.
strings.排列编码 + 禁忌表防回边: Permutation encoding + tabu list against backtracking
strings.排列编码 + OX 交叉换解码器: Permutation encoding + OX crossover with a swapped decoder
strings.蚂蚁着色图：信息素引导的列表着色是图着色元启发式的早期代表作（Costa & H: Ant colouring: pheromone-guided list colouring is an early representative of graph-colouring metaheuristics (Costa & Hertz, J. Oper. Res. Soc. 48:295, 1997)
strings.为什么收敛曲线是阶梯状的？: Why is the convergence curve step-shaped?
strings.色数是整数——算法从 11 色降到 10 色之间不会出现「10.5 色」。平台期: The colour count is an integer — between 11 and 10 colours there is no “10.5 colours”. During a plateau the algorithm optimises the secondary measure Σci² (using colours more compactly and emptying high-numbered buckets) and builds up enough potential to jump to the next count. When reading the curve, mainly watch when the red step drops.
strings.什么是 DSJC 实例？为什么不用好看的几何图？: What is a DSJC instance? Why not use nice-looking geometric graphs?
strings.DSJC = 均匀随机连边（Johnson 等 1991 年起的图着色标准基准）: DSJC = edges drawn uniformly at random (a standard graph-colouring benchmark since Johnson et al., 1991). Lesson from measurement: random geometric graphs (vertices scattered in the plane and joined by distance) are too structured — random-order First-Fit is already nearly optimal and all algorithms sit at the floor with no measurable difference. With DSJC p = 0.5, random order gives 12 colours versus 10–11 after optimisation: a real gap.
strings.排列编码在这里怎么工作？: How does the permutation encoding work here?
strings.解 = 顶点排列，解码 = 按顺序 First-Fit 染色：轮到谁，就给它邻居: Solution = a vertex permutation, decoding = First-Fit colouring in that order: whoever is next gets the smallest colour its neighbours have not used. Vertices early in the order have more choice, those later take what is left — so “put the hard-to-colour vertices first” is the right direction, and that is the order the algorithms swap and cross. A valid colouring is guaranteed by construction and no repair operator is ever needed.
strings.把 n 件物品塞进容量固定的箱子，用最少的箱子。物流装载、资源调度、内存分配的抽: Pack n items into bins of fixed capacity using as few bins as possible. The abstract prototype of cargo loading, resource scheduling and memory allocation.
strings.装箱与图着色共用同一套骨架：解 = 物品的一个排列，解码 = 按排列顺序把物品放: Bin packing and graph colouring share the same skeleton: solution = a permutation of the items, decoding = put each item in permutation order into “the first bin it fits in” (First-Fit). Again a permutation encoding with a swapped decoder — the general formula of metaheuristics across problems, staged for the third time.
strings.目标函数是「箱数 b + Σ剩余²」字典序：箱数是主指标，剩余容量平方和鼓励箱子: The objective is the lexicographic “number of bins b + Σ residual²”: the bin count is the main criterion and the sum of squared leftover capacities rewards tightly packed bins — once the bin count hits the lower bound, algorithms are compared on how tight the packing is. The page shows LB = ⌈Σ weights / capacity⌉: no packing can use fewer than LB bins, and reaching LB means optimal.
strings.物品重量 U[20,100]、容量 150：LB≈n/2.5，First-Fit: With item weights U[20,100] and capacity 150: LB ≈ n/2.5, First-Fit Decreasing (FFD) typically gives LB + 1 while random-order FF is 2–3 bins worse — the room for optimisation is real.
strings.箱数触到 LB=⌈Σ重量/容量⌉ 就是数学意义上的最优（不可能更少）——种群+m: A bin count that touches LB = ⌈Σ weights / capacity⌉ is mathematically optimal (there cannot be fewer) — the population + memetic algorithms (GA / ABC / WOA / HC) all reached it. SA/TS tie on the bin count but clearly lose on tightness (Σ residual²): on a bin-count plateau look at the secondary measure. The gap widens on the 60/80-item instances.
strings.排列编码 + First-Fit 装箱解码 + 降温: Permutation encoding + First-Fit bin-packing decoding + cooling
strings.排列编码 + 交叉变异 + First-Fit: Permutation encoding + crossover and mutation + First-Fit
strings.构造式装填 + 信息素（适应度=箱数）: Constructive packing + pheromone (fitness = number of bins)
strings.LB 是什么？为什么触到 LB 就不用再跑了？: What is LB? Why can you stop once LB is reached?
strings.LB = ⌈所有物品总重 ÷ 箱容量⌉，是最多可能的数学下界——不管多聪明的装法: LB = ⌈total weight of all items ÷ bin capacity⌉ is the strongest simple mathematical lower bound — however clever the packing, the total weight is what it is and there cannot be fewer bins. So a bin count equal to LB is optimal, and what remains for the algorithms to compare is “who is closer when LB is not reached, and how tight the packing is”.
strings.箱数一样时比什么？: What is compared when the bin counts are equal?
strings.比 Σ剩余²（所有箱子剩余容量的平方和）。它鼓励「要么塞满、要么留大空位」——小: Σ residual² (the sum of the squared leftover capacities of all bins). It encourages “either packed full or left with a big gap” — many small fragmented gaps are the worst shape. This is also the standard secondary objective in the bin-packing literature: the main measure (bin count) is an integer plateau and the secondary measure provides a continuous gradient for the algorithms.
strings.和 TSP 用的编码一样吗？: Is the encoding the same as for TSP?
strings.一样，都是排列！TSP 把排列当访问顺序、图着色当染色优先级、装箱当装填顺序——: Yes — a permutation in all three! TSP treats it as a visiting order, graph colouring as a colouring priority, bin packing as a packing order — three problems, three decoders, and the algorithms (swap / insertion / OX crossover / annealing) unchanged. This is the best evidence for the site's skeleton “algorithm = mechanism, problem binding = encoding + decoding”: the 7 algorithms on this page run from the same code as on the graph-colouring page.
strings.两个收益互相冲突的背包：目标1 和目标2 都想最大化。输出不再是一个解，而是一整: A knapsack with two conflicting profits: objective 1 and objective 2 should both be maximised. The output is no longer one solution but a whole Pareto front — watch how it spreads out generation by generation.
strings.多目标与单目标的本质区别：两个目标冲突时（同一件物品对目标1 好可能对目标2 差: The essential difference between multi-objective and single-objective: when two objectives conflict (an item that is good for objective 1 may be bad for objective 2), no solution is best on all objectives, and one can only look for a set of mutually non-dominated trade-offs (the Pareto front).
strings.散点图里：灰点=种群，红点=当前 Pareto 前沿，越靠右上角越好。重点看 N: In the scatter plot: grey points = population, red points = current Pareto front, and the closer to the upper right the better. Focus on the difference between NSGA-II and the “weighted GA” baseline — the latter draws random weights every generation to form a single objective, and the population collapses to one point with no diversity; NSGA-II's crowding-distance mechanism exists to prevent exactly that. This is why the Pareto framework (Deb et al. 2002, tens of thousands of citations) became the default starting point.
strings.只会丢掉被支配点，增长慢: Only discards dominated points, grows slowly
strings.种群坍缩到一个折中点——加权法的经典弱点: The population collapses to one compromise point — the classic weakness of the weighted-sum method
strings.拥挤度机制主动保持前沿铺开: The crowding-distance mechanism actively keeps the front spread out
strings.这个对照就是多目标优化的核心一课：加权标量化会把多样性压没（还漏掉非凸前沿段），: This comparison is the core lesson of multi-objective optimisation: weighted scalarisation squeezes out diversity (and misses non-convex parts of the front), while the Pareto framework can spread over the whole front.
strings.加权标量化：每代随机权重合成单目标（会坍缩——本站用它当反面教材）: Weighted scalarisation: random weights combine the objectives every generation (it collapses — the site uses it as a counter-example)
strings.多目标域实测：非支配解数 1 vs NSGA-II 的 40: Multi-objective domain, measured: 1 non-dominated solution vs 40 for NSGA-II
strings.为什么叫 Pareto 前沿？: Why is it called the Pareto front?
strings.经济学家 Pareto 提出：无法在不损害任何一方的前提下再改进任何一方，就是「: The economist Pareto proposed that when no one can be improved without harming someone else, the situation is “Pareto efficient”. In multi-objective optimisation every point on the front is a different efficient compromise — which one to choose is up to the decision maker, and the algorithm's job is to spread the front out.
strings.加权法到底差在哪？: Where exactly does the weighted method fall short?
strings.①每换一组权重才得到一个点，铺满前沿要跑很多次；②非凸前沿段用任何权重都够不到；: ① Each new set of weights gives only one point, so covering the front needs many runs; ② non-convex parts of the front cannot be reached with any weights; ③ when the weights change during evolution the objective changes, the population is pulled back and forth and finally collapses to a few points — the weighted-GA comparison on this page is a live demonstration.
strings.同一非支配层里，某个解周围越空旷，拥挤度越小（本站实现按邻居距离和算）。NSGA: Within a non-dominated layer, the emptier the surroundings of a solution, the larger its crowding distance (here computed as the sum of the distances to its neighbours). NSGA-II prefers keeping solutions in sparse regions and prevents the front from clustering — this is the key mechanism that lets it “spread out”.
